Henriette Vind Thaysen is a clinical nurse specialist involved in the national governance and quality assurance of acute surgical care in Denmark [^src1]. She serves as a member of the [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] (Steering Committee) for the Acute Surgery Database (Akut Kirurgi Databasen), a national clinical quality database that tracks performance indicators for acute surgical conditions [^src1]. 

Within the steering committee, Thaysen represents both the Danish Society for Clinical Nutrition (Dansk Selskab for Klinisk Ernæring) and Aarhus University Hospital (Aarhus Universitetshospital), which operates within the Central Denmark Region (Region Midtjylland) [^src1]. Her role on the committee is significant for ensuring that the clinical nursing perspective is actively integrated into the database's quality development initiatives, the evaluation of clinical indicators, and the broader systemic efforts to improve care for acute high-risk patients [^src1].
